name: io.github.WYRE-AI/foundu-mcp
title: foundU
description: Read-only foundU workforce data: employees, rosters, shifts, timesheets, leave, and reports.

headers.name: X-Gateway-S2S
headers.description: Service-to-service proof, t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of 't=<unix seconds>' keyed with CONDUIT_S2S_SECRET>, minted per request by the WYRE MCP Gateway. Requests without a valid, fresh proof get 401.

headers.name: X-FoundU-Access-Token
headers.description: The tenant's short-lived foundU OAuth2 access token, without a 'Bearer ' prefix. Read per request in AUTH_MODE=gateway (the image default); this server never refreshes it.

environmentVariables.name: CONDUIT_S2S_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Per-vendor S2S secret provisioned by the WYRE MCP Gateway (openssl rand -hex 32). The image refuses to start without a real one.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the HTTP transport listens on inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated Host header allowlist for /mcp.

environmentVariables.name: FOUNDU_TOOL_TIERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool tiers. read is the only tier (every tool is read-only). The X-Conduit-Tool-Tiers request header can only narrow this set.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
